verdict.rationale: vLLM's first-party docs explicitly list GGUF among its supported quantization formats, which covers the core of the story. The only evidence is a single line in a feature list, with no docs on how to load or serve GGUF models and no independent confirmation. Missing for 10: GGUF-specific loading/serving documentation (e.g., how to point vLLM at a .gguf file, tokenizer handling, supported architectures), any stated limitations, and independent or hands-on corroboration that GGUF models run.
